items.title: 68642_Jo Jones oral history interview
items.q: Eddie Cantor takes Thelma Carpenter away from us... She's with Eddie Cantor, man, we can't pay her.

ctx.x: Kelly's Stables in Chicago, you mean?

New York, 52nd Street. I went down there and I said, 'She's ready now.' She'd grown up a little bit. So we brought her back into the band. Meanwhile Eddie Cantor takes Thelma Carpenter away from us, 'cause Thelma was 'way before Hazel Scott or Lena Horne was gone before Dinah Shore or anybody.
Can I ask, how many times did Thelma return to the band?
